registered: 2026-11-25, before the global searches were run
reference_tools: SciPy 1.18: a brute-force scan of the allocation (2,001 points) refined by bounded Brent minimisation (scipy.optimize.minimize_scalar) for each instant, and a 60-step bisection on speed for the steady limit; both on the same force and yaw balance and tyre table as torque_distribution.state, so this checks the search, not the model

cases.instants: V 8 to 20 m/s, curvature 1/6 to 1/25 1/m, longitudinal acceleration -8 to +6 m/s2, every option

limit_notes: KinematiK's search is a 25-point scan plus 18 golden-section steps; 0.002 in utilisation is the size of a grid step on a smooth cost.
